explanation: It is non-zero only at the GO step, and only when the agent chooses a1 right after a trial that reached S1 and was rewarded (how S1 was reached, common or rare, does not matter); every other step and case is 0, including D1, D2, a2 choices, and a1 choices after no reward or after a reward in S2. Its height depends on how early in the episode it is: about 10 in the first ~12 trials, about 3-7 around trials 25-35, and 0 from about trial 40 onward.
